SUBSTITUTE
NARRATIVE
Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment
4301 W. Montrose Avenue
From RT3.5 to C2-1

The subject property is improved with a one-story brick motor vehicle repair shop, now vacant and a
paved asphalt work area. The applicant proposes to convert the use of the existing building to a Business
Support Service for indoor storage and change the use of the existing vehicle use area to an Outdoor
Work Area for an outdoor training area for the use of the trade school at 4300 W. Montrose Avenue.
There will be no on-site parking.

Under the relief provided by Sec. 17-10-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance the Applicant seeks
relief from Secs.17-13-1101-B to reduce the east side yard setback from 6.5 feet to zero and the rear yard
setback from 6.3 feet to zero. The Applicant seeks all relief as needed, as allowed by the Zoning
Ordinance, for the attached plans.

Proposed Zoning: C2-1, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.
1) Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio
a) Lot Area 14,403.87 sq. ft. (No change)
b) Total building area 1,260.96 sq. ft. (No change)
c) FAR 0.08 (No change)
2) Minimum Lot Area per Unit N/A
3) Amount of Off-Street Parking 0
4) Setbacks Front (north): 0.0 ft. (No change)

Rear (south): 0.0 ft. (By Variation)
Side (east): 0.0 ft. (By Variation)
Side (west): 0.0 ft. (No change)

5) Height 15.0 ft. (No change)

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant s seeks relief from Secs.17-13-1101-B to reduce the
east side yard setback from 6.5 feet to zero and the rear yard setback from 6.3 feet to zero.

The Applicant seeks all relief as needed, as allowed by the Zoning Ordinance, for the attached plans.
